privacy_header_title: Aap ki privacy hamare liye intehai ahem hai
privacy_last_updated: Aakhri baar update kiya gaya: January 2026
privacy_sec1_title: 1. Hum kaun sa data jama karte hain?
privacy_sec1_content: Hum aap ka naam, username, profile tasweer, game character ID (UID) aur email address jama karte hain jab aap account banate hain.
privacy_sec2_title: 2. Data ka istemal kaise kiya jata hai?
privacy_sec2_content: Aap ka data aap ki profile ko behtar banane, tournaments aur matches ke intezamat, aur community ke usoolon par amal daramad ke liye istemal hota hai.
privacy_sec3_content: Hum aap ke zaati data ki hifazat ke liye jadeed encryption aur security ke behtareen tareeqay istemal karte hain.
privacy_sec4_content: Hum aap ke tajarbay ko behtar banane aur tarjeehat ko mehfooz rakhne ke liye local storage aur cookies ka istemal karte hain.
privacy_sec5_content: Hum Google sign-in aur ishteharati networks jaisi mehfooz third-party khidmat istemal karte hain jo unki apni privacy policies ke tehat kaam karti hain.
privacy_sec6_content: Aap ko kisi bhi waqt apna profile data dekhne, is mein tarmeem karne ya 'Mera data download karein' ke option se copy hasil karne ka mukammal haq hasil hai.
privacy_sec7_content: Hum 13 saal se kam umar bachon ka data jaan boojh kar jama nahi karte. Yeh app 13+ saal ke sarfeen ke liye banayi gayi hai.
privacy_sec8_content: Hum waqtan fawaqtan is privacy policy mein tabdeelian kar sakte hain. Ahem tabdeeliyon ka notification app mein de diya jaye ga.
terms_header_desc: Gamers ID app istemal karne se pehle in sharait o zawabit ko ghaur se parh lein.
terms_last_updated: Aakhri baar update kiya gaya: January 2026
terms_sec1_item1: • Is app ko download ya istemal kar ke aap in sharait se ittifaq karte hain.
terms_sec1_item2: • Agar aap in sharait se muttafiq nahi hain, toh barahe karam app istemal na karein.
terms_sec1_item3: • Tamam sarfeen ke liye app ki policies ki pabandi karna laazmi hai.
terms_sec2_item1: • Aap ka account aur is ki security aap ki apni zimmedari hai.
terms_sec2_item2: • Ek shakhs sirf ek hi asal gamer ID bana sakta hai.
terms_sec2_item3: • Ghalat ya fake maloomat dene par account moattal kiya ja sakta hai.
terms_sec2_item4: • Profile naam aur bio mein na-munasib zaban istemal karna mana hai.
terms_sec3_item1: • Doosre gamers ke sath izzat aur ehtaram se pesh aayein.
terms_sec3_item2: • Harassment, gaali galoch ya nafrat angez zaban par sakht pabandi hai.
terms_sec3_item3: • Chats ya posts mein ghair mutaaliqa ya spam links share na karein.
terms_sec3_item4: • Fake screenshots ya ghalat saboot jama karwana mamnoo hai.
terms_sec3_item5: • Community guidelines torne par account mustaqil ban ho sakta hai.
terms_sec3_item6: • Admin ka faisla hatmi aur sab ke liye qabil-e-qabool hoga.
terms_sec4_item1: • Custom rooms aur tournaments mein di gayi hidayat par sakhti se amal karein.
terms_sec4_item2: • Match ke dauran hacking ya cheating ka istemal karne par na-ahal kar diya jaye ga.
terms_sec4_item3: • Inaamat aur coins sirf usool pooray karne wale fateheen ko milein ge.
terms_sec4_item4: • Match ke nataij par tanaza hone ki soorat mein admin saboot ki jaanch kare ga.
terms_sec5_item1: • G-Coins sirf app ke androoni features aur inaamat ke liye hain.
terms_sec5_item2: • Coins ko ghair qanooni tareeqon se hasil karne ki koshish na karein.
terms_sec5_item3: • Daily bonus aur referral systems ke tay shuda usool laagu hon ge.
terms_sec5_item4: • Company kisi bhi waqt coins policy mein tabdeeli ka haq mehfooz rakhti hai.
terms_sec6_item1: • Aap app par jo bhi clips ya posts share karein ge, aap khud is ke zimmedar hain.
terms_sec6_item2: • Copyright ya chori shuda mawad upload karne ki ijazat nahi.
terms_sec6_item3: • Na-munasib ya baligh mawad (Adult Content) share karne par sakht karwai hogi.
terms_sec6_item4: • Admin ko yeh ikhtiyar hasil hai ke woh kisi bhi post ko delete kar sakay.
terms_sec7_item1: • Aap ka zaati data hamari privacy policy ke tehat mehfooz rehta hai.
terms_sec7_item2: • Hum aap ka koi bhi data kisi fareeq-e-saalis ko nahi bechte.
terms_sec7_item3: • Aap kisi bhi waqt apna account ya data delete karne ki darkhwast de sakte hain.
terms_sec7_item4: • App ki behtari ke liye analytics ka istemal kiya jata hai.
terms_sec8_item1: • App mein dikhaye jane wale ishteharat sponsors ki taraf se hote hain.
terms_sec8_item2: • Bairooni websites ya links ki security ki zimmedari hamari nahi hai.
terms_sec8_item3: • Rewarded ads dekhne par tay shuda coins aap ke wallet mein shamil kiye jayein ge.
terms_sec8_item4: • Ishteharat ke sath chher chhar ya bypass karne ki koshish na karein.
terms_sec9_item1: • Sharait ki khilaf warzi par aap ka account aarzi ya mustaqil band ho sakta hai.
terms_sec9_item2: • Moattal shuda account ke coins ya data ki wapsi ki koi zamant nahi.
terms_sec9_item3: • Moattali ke khilaf appeal ke liye aap support team se rabta kar sakte hain.
terms_sec10_item1: • App ko baghair kisi zamant (As Is) ke faraham kiya ja raha hai.
terms_sec10_item2: • Internet connection ya server ki kharabi ki wajah se hone wale nuqsan ke hum zimmedar nahi.
terms_sec10_item3: • Gamers ID Network kisi bhi takneeki kharabi ke liye zimmedar nahi hoga.
terms_sec11_item1: • Hum kisi bhi waqt in service ki sharait mein tabdeeli kar sakte hain.
terms_sec11_item2: • Bari tabdeeliyon ka itlaaq app par notice ke baad ho jaye ga.
terms_sec11_item3: • App ka musalsal istemal in nayi sharait ki qabooliat samjha jaye ga.
